title: iSpecimen Inc.
text: EX-10.4 6 ea031141601ex10-4.htm FORM OF LOCK-UP AGREEMENT Exhibit 10.4 LOCK-UP AGREEMENT November 5, 2026 iSpecimen Inc. 8 Cabot Road, Suite 1800 Woburn, MA 01801 E.F. Hutton & Co. 745 Fifth Avenue, 34th Floor & PH New York, NY 10151 Re: Placement Agency Agreement, dated as of November 5, 2026 (the “ Placement Agency Agreement ”), between iSpecimen Inc. (the “ Company ”) and E.F. Hutton & Co. (the “ Placement Agent ”), and Securities Purchase Agreement, dated as of November 5, 2026 (the “ Purchase Agreement ”), among the Company and the purchasers party thereto Ladies and Gentlemen: Defined terms not otherwise defined in this letter agreement (the “ Letter Agreement ”) shall have the meanings set forth in the Placement Agency Agreement. In satisfaction of a condition of the Placement Agent’s obligations under the Placement Agency Agreement and the Purchasers’ obligations under the Purchase Agreement, the undersigned irrevocably agrees with the Company and the Placement Agent that, from the date hereof until ninety (90) days after the Closing Date (such period, the “ Restriction Period ”), the undersigned will not offer, sell, contract to sell, hypothecate, pledge or otherwise dispose of (or enter into any transaction which is designed to, or might reasonably be expected to, result in the disposition (whether by actual disposition or effective economic disposition due to cash settlement or otherwise) by the undersigned or any Affiliate of the undersigned or any person in privity with the undersigned or any Affiliate of the undersigned), directly or indirectly, or establish or increase a put equivalent position or liquidate or decrease a call equivalent position within the meaning of Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “ Exchange Act ”), with respect to, any shares of Common Stock of the Company or securities convertible into, exchangeable or exercisable for shares of Common Stock of the Company beneficially owned, held or hereafter acquired by the undersigned (the “ Lock-Up Securities ”), excluding any securities issued or issuable as consideration in connection with the Company’s asset purchase transaction with Foldlab AI that are held in escrow and subject to a separate lock-up agreement (the “ Foldlab Securities ”), which shall not constitute Lock-Up Securities or otherwise be subject to this Letter Agreement and shall instead be governed solely by such separate lock-up agreement, or make any demand for or exercise any right or cause to be filed a registration statement, including any amendments thereto, with respect to the registration of any shares of Common Stock or Common Stock Equivalents, or publicly disclose the intention to do any of the foregoing. Beneficial ownership shall be calculated in accordance with Section 13(d) of the Exchange Act. All references to the number or amount of shares of Common Stock or other securities hereunder shall be appropriately adjusted to give effect to any reverse or forward stock split, stock dividend, stock combination, recapitalization or similar transaction occurring after the date hereof. The undersigned acknowledges that the Company shall provide written notice to the transfer agent of the Company to inform it of the Restriction Period, which written notice shall include notification by email. In order to enforce this covenant, the Company shall impose irrevocable stop-transfer instructions preventing the transfer agent of the Company from effecting any actions in violation of this Letter Agreement. The Placement Agent shall serve as the sole lock-up release agent for the Restriction Period. The Placement Agent may, in its sole discretion, consent to or waive any restriction or condition hereunder, or release any Lock-Up Securities from the restrictions hereunder, by written notice to the Company and the undersigned; provided that any such consent, waiver or release shall be effective only upon delivery of such written notice to the Company and the undersigned, and the Company shall promptly notify the transfer agent thereof. For the avoidance of doubt, no stockholder of the Company that is not a director or executive officer of the Company shall be required by the Company or the Placement Agent to execute this Letter Agreement, and neither the Company nor the Placement Agent shall be obligated to compel any such stockholder to do so. Notwithstanding the foregoing, and subject to the conditions below, the undersigned may transfer the Lock-Up Securities in the circumstances described in clauses (i) through (viii) below, provided that (1) the Company and the Placement Agent receive a signed lock-up letter agreement (in the form of this Letter Agreement) for the balance of the Restriction Period from each donee, trustee, distributee or transferee, as the case may be, prior to such transfer, (2) any such transfer shall not involve a disposition for value, (3) any filing required under Section 16 of the Exchange Act in connection with any such transfer may be made, provided that such filing identifies the applicable permitted transfer and states that it was made pursuant to a permitted exception under this Letter Agreement, and (4) neither the undersigned nor any donee, trustee, distributee or transferee, as the case may be, otherwise voluntarily effects any public filing or report regarding such transfers during the Restriction Period. The transfer described in clause (ix) below shall be permitted notwithstanding conditions (1) and (2), subject to the conditions expressly set forth in clause (ix): (i) as a bona fide gift or gifts, including gifts made for estate-planning purposes; (ii) to any immediate family member or to any trust for the direct or indirect benefit of the undersigned or the immediate family of the undersigned (for purposes of this Letter Agreement, “immediate family” shall mean any relationship by blood, marriage or adoption, not more remote than first cousin); (iii) to any corporation, partnership, limited liability company or other business entity all of the equity holders of which consist of the undersigned and/or the immediate family of the undersigned; (iv) if the undersigned is a corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust or other business entity, (a) to another corporation, partnership, limited liability company, trust or other business entity that is an Affiliate of the undersigned or (b) in the form of a distribution to limited partners, limited liability company members or stockholders of the undersigned; (v) if the undersigned is a trust, to the beneficiary of such trust; (vi) by operation of law, such as pursuant to a qualified domestic order, divorce settlement, divorce decree, separation agreement or other court order; (vii) to a charity or educational institution; (viii) by will, other testamentary document or intestate succession to the legal representative, heir, beneficiary or a member of the immediate family of the undersigned; or (ix) sales of Common Stock made pursuant to and in accordance with a trading plan pursuant to Rule 10b5-1 under the Exchange Act established and in effect prior to the date hereof, provided that any filing under Section 16 of the Exchange Act made in connection with such sales shall state that such sales were made pursuant to such trading plan; 2 In addition, notwithstanding the foregoing, this Letter Agreement shall not restrict (i) the delivery of shares of Common Stock to the undersigned upon exercise of any options or settlement of restricted stock units or other equity awards granted under any employee benefit plan of the Company, or the exercise of warrants, including any cashless or net exercise, provided in each case that any shares of Common Stock or other securities acquired in connection with any such exercise or settlement will remain subject to the restrictions set forth in this Letter Agreement, (ii) the withholding, surrender or sale of shares of Common Stock to cover the payment of exercise prices, tax withholding obligations or other taxes associated with the exercise or settlement of equity awards described in clause (i) above, including any net exercise or net settlement, (iii) the grant, issuance, vesting, settlement, exercise, cancellation or administration of awards by the Company pursuant to any equity incentive plan, employee benefit plan, agreement or arrangement, (iv) any sale or other transfer of shares of Common Stock acquired by the undersigned in open-market transactions after the Closing Date, so long as such shares were not acquired from the Company or any of its Affiliates, or (v) any transfer of Lock-Up Securities pursuant to a tender offer, merger, consolidation, business combination, change of control transaction or sale of all or substantially all of the assets of the Company, in each case approved by the Company’s board of directors. The undersigned acknowledges that the execution, delivery and performance of this Letter Agreement is a material inducement to the Placement Agent and the Purchasers to complete the transactions contemplated by the Placement Agency Agreement and the Purchase Agreement, and the Company and the Placement Agent shall each be entitled to specific performance of the undersigned’s obligations hereunder. The undersigned hereby represents that the undersigned has the power and authority to execute, deliver and perform this Letter Agreement, that the undersigned has received adequate consideration therefor and that the undersigned will indirectly benefit from the closing of the transactions contemplated by the Placement Agency Agreement and the Purchase Agreement. For purposes of this Letter Agreement and the lock-up requirements applicable to executive officers of the Company, any person serving as an executive officer through a contractor, consulting or other service entity shall be treated as an executive officer notwithstanding the form of engagement, including Shahin Behroyan, who serves as Chief Executive Officer through 1605811 BC Ltd. If an executive officer serves through such an entity, the individual and the entity shall be subject to the restrictions in this Letter Agreement with respect to any Lock-Up Securities beneficially owned, held or hereafter acquired by either, and the entity shall execute this Letter Agreement or a written joinder thereto, or otherwise agree in writing to be bound by this Letter Agreement. This Letter Agreement shall automatically terminate and be of no further force or effect upon the earliest to occur of (i) the termination of the Purchase Agreement in accordance with its terms or the Purchase Agreement otherwise ceasing to be effective, (ii) the failure of the Closing to occur on or before the Outside Date (as defined in the Purchase Agreement), and (iii) the expiration of the Restriction Period. Upon any such termination, the undersigned shall be released from all obligations under this Letter Agreement, except for any obligations that expressly survive termination. This Letter Agreement may not be amended or otherwise modified in any respect without the written consent of each of the Company, the Placement Agent and the undersigned. This Letter Agreement shall be construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of the State of New York without regard to the principles of conflicts of law. Nothing contained herein shall be deemed to limit in any way any right to serve process in any manner permitted by law. The undersigned agrees and understands that this Letter Agreement does not intend to create any relationship between the undersigned and the Placement Agent other than as expressly set forth herein, that the Placement Agent is not entitled to cast any votes on the matters herein contemplated and that no issuance or sale of the Lock-Up Securities is created or intended by virtue of this Letter Agreement. This Letter Agreement shall be binding on successors and assigns of the undersigned with respect to the Lock-Up Securities and any such successor or assign shall enter into a similar agreement for the benefit of the Company and the Placement Agent. This Letter Agreement may be executed in two or more counterparts, all of which when taken together may be considered one and the same agreement, and delivery of an executed counterpart by email (including .pdf) or other electronic transmission shall be as effective as delivery of a manually executed counterpart. text: EX-10.1 2 ea031130201ex10-1.htm AMENDMENT NO.1 TO THE YOUNGSTOWN COMPUTING CENTER EQUITY TRANSFER AGREEMENT, DATED NOVEMBER 3, 2026, BETWEEN VALOR ENERGY INC. AND GLORIOUS STAR, LLC Exhibit 10.1 AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO YOUNGSTOWN COMPUTING CENTER EQUITY TRANSFER AGREEMENT This Amendment No.1 to Youngstown Computing Center Equity Transfer Agreement (this “Amendment”) is entered into as of the date of the last signature below (the “Amendment Effective Date”) by and between Valor Energy Inc., a Nevada corporation (“Buyer” or “VAI”), and Glorious Star, LLC, (the “Seller” and the “Target Company”), joins this Amendment to acknowledge the terms of this Amendment and reaffirm their obligations under the Agreement as amended hereby. BACKGROUND WHEREAS , Buyer and Seller entered into the Youngstown Computing Center Equity Transfer Agreement executed by Buyer and Seller on October 18, 2026 (the “Agreement”), concerning the acquisition of all outstanding equity interests of the Target Company; WHEREAS , the parties to the Agreement wish to amend certain provisions of the Agreement relating to the payment of the purchase price and related closing and termination arrangements, as set forth in this Amendment; and WHEREAS , pursuant to Section 7.3 of the Agreement, this Amendment constitutes a written agreement signed by Buyer and Seller to effectuate the amendments to the Agreement specified below. NOW, THEREFORE , in consideration of the foregoing and the respective covenants and agreements set forth herein, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Defined Terms; Purchase Price. Capitalized terms not defined in this Amendment have the meanings assigned in the Agreement. The aggregate purchase price under Section 4.1 remains USD 3,600,000. Neither the Initial Valuation nor the Final Valuation Report shall automatically adjust that purchase price. The separate reimbursements, allocations, and other arrangements under Sections 4.5 through 4.8 remain unchanged, except that “final payment” in Section 4.8 means the balance payment under Section 4.3 as amended hereby. No amount shall be paid or reimbursed twice. 2. Payments by Buyer’s Subsidiaries. The following is added to Section 1.2 of the Agreement: “Buyer may make payments directly or cause one or more of its directly or indirectly controlled subsidiaries, identified to Seller in writing, to make payments on Buyer’s behalf. Payments received by Seller shall discharge Buyer’s corresponding payment obligations only to the extent received. Such payments do not change the identity of the Acquiring Entity, constitute an assignment or novation, or release Buyer from any obligation under this Agreement. The existing designation and assumption requirements applicable to an Acquiring Entity remain in effect.” 3. Replacement of Sections 4.2 and 4.3. Sections 4.2 and 4.3 of the Agreement are deleted and replaced with the following: 4.2 “Initial Valuation” means the preliminary written valuation prepared by Buyer concerning the Target Company and its interests in the Project. Buyer shall pay, or cause payment of, USD 360,000 directly to Seller no later than 11:59 p.m., New York time on November 3, 2026, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Seller in writing and independently verified by Buyer (the “Down Payment”). No Down Payment shall be due before Buyer delivers that written confirmation. The Down Payment constitutes partial payment of the purchase price, is non-refundable except as expressly provided in Section 4.4, and shall be credited dollar-for-dollar against the purchase price at Closing. The Down Payment shall not be held in escrow or in an attorney trust account. Its payment does not constitute Closing, transfer equity or control, or waive any remaining Closing condition, Seller obligation, or termination right under this Agreement. 4.3 “Final Valuation Report” means the final written valuation report prepared and approved by Buyer concerning the Target Company and its interests in the Project, expressly identified as final and bearing its issuance date. Buyer shall deliver the Final Valuation Report to Seller concurrently with issuance. A preliminary draft, internal working paper, or Initial Valuation does not constitute the Final Valuation Report. The “Payment Deadline” is the thirtieth (30th) Business Day after the original Effective Date of the Agreement, October 18, 2026, and shall not be extended unless Buyer and Seller agree otherwise in writing. Issuance, delivery, correction or revision of the Final Valuation Report shall not extend or restart the Payment Deadline. Subject to satisfaction or written waiver by the benefited party of all Closing conditions that may lawfully be waived, Buyer shall pay, or cause payment of, the remaining USD 3,240,000 directly to Seller at Closing, no later than the Payment Deadline. Such payment shall be made by wire transfer of immediately available funds to Seller’s designated and independently verified account, simultaneously with Seller’s delivery of 100% of the equity interests and control under Section 5.5. Buyer shall not be required to pay that balance before the applicable Closing conditions and concurrent deliveries are met. The Down Payment previously received by Seller shall be credited against the purchase price and shall not be paid again or require any further release. If there are multiple Sellers, they shall jointly provide written payment and allocation instructions. Aggregate purchase-price payments shall not exceed USD 3,600,000. 4. Replacement of Section 4.4. Section 4.4 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced with the following: 4.4 Except for the Down Payment payable under Section 4.2, Buyer shall retain the unpaid purchase price until Closing. Upon a valid termination under this Agreement, Buyer’s further acquisition and unpaid purchase-price obligations shall cease, without prejudice to independently accrued breach claims. The Down payment is non-refundable, and termination alone does not entitle Buyer to its repayment. [However, if Buyer validly terminates under Section 5.3, 6.2 or 6.3 as a result of Seller’s fraud, material misrepresentation or material breach of this Agreement, after compliance with any notice and cure requirements applicable to that termination, Seller shall refund the Down Payment actually received within five (5) Business Days after receipt of Buyer’s termination notice. This refund obligation survives termination.] This Section governs the consequences of termination and does not create an independent termination right. Except for retention of the Down Payment as provided herein, Buyer shall not be liable for a break-up fee or liquidated damages solely because of its valid termination under Section 5.3 or 6.2. Independently accrued breach claims remain available, but no double recovery for the same loss is permitted. Any Down Payment retained by Seller shall be credited against damages recovered by Seller for the same loss. 5. Replacement of Section 5.1. Section 5.1 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced with the following: 5.1 The Due Diligence Period remains thirty Business Days from the original Effective Date of the Agreement, October 18, 2026, unless Buyer and Seller expressly agree otherwise in writing. This Amendment does not restart that period. The Closing Deadline supersedes the reference to the ninetieth (90th) Business Day in former Section 5.1. Buyer shall proceed promptly and in good faith with due diligence and preparation of the Initial Valuation and Final Valuation Report. Completion of due diligence or issuance or delivery of either valuation shall not extend the Closing Deadline. The “Closing Deadline” shall be the Payment Deadline determined under Section 4.3. Subject to satisfaction or lawful written waiver of the Closing conditions under Section 5.4, Closing and payment of the remaining purchase price shall occur simultaneously on a date agreed by Buyer and Seller, no later than the Closing Deadline. Absent agreement on an earlier date, Closing shall occur on the Closing Deadline. Any extension of the Closing Deadline requires Buyer’s and Seller’s written agreement. 2 6. Valuation Cooperation and Closing Conditions. The following is added to Section 5.2: “Seller shall cause the Target Company to cooperate reasonably with Buyer’s preparation of the Initial Valuation and Final Valuation Report, including by promptly providing reasonably requested information and access and notifying Buyer of material inaccuracies in or changes to information previously supplied.” Section 5.4(a) is replaced with: “(a) Buyer’s written confirmation that the Initial Valuation and due diligence results are satisfactory, and issuance and delivery of the Final Valuation Report on or before the Closing Deadline” Sections 5.4(b) through (g), including the requirement to satisfy mandatory legal conditions, remain unchanged. 7. Due Diligence Termination. Section 5.3 is replaced and restated with the following: 5.3 If, during the Due Diligence Period specified under Section 5.1, the Buyer determines, based on objective facts and reasonable judgment, that the Target Company has provided false information to the Buyer, the Buyer may unilaterally terminate the Agreement by written notice to the Seller. The treatment of any Down Payment following termination shall be governed exclusively by Section 4.4. Absent false information, Buyer has no unilateral termination right under this Section 5.3; provided that this limitation does not restrict rights under Sections 6.2 or 6.3 or require payment before the applicable payment conditions have been met. 8. Simultaneous Closing. Section 5.5 is replaced and restated with the following: 5.5 At Closing, Seller shall deliver: valid 100% equity transfer instruments, updated membership register and applicable equity certificates and registration documents; the Target Company’s Operating Agreement and amendments (including the amendment reflecting Buyer or its designated subsidiary as the sole member of the Target Company), resolutions, licenses, seals, books, bank and system control credentials; replacement documents for directors, managers and other personnel as required by Buyer; original land, power and permit contract texts and no-default certificates; encumbrance release and historical debt cleanup certificates; mechanics’ lien waivers or releases from contractors under Chapter 1311 of the Ohio Revised Code; and the site plan, resource inventory, Closing statement and Closing confirmation signed by both parties. Equity transfer, control handover, and payment of the remaining purchase price under Section 4.3 shall occur simultaneously at Closing. The Down Payment previously received by Seller shall be credited dollar-for-dollar against the purchase price in the Closing statement, without any further payment or release of the Down Payment. Project assets and contract rights shall remain held by the Target Company. Buyer shall review Closing documents reasonably and promptly and shall complete Closing in accordance with Sections 4.3 and 5.1, subject to satisfaction or written waiver by the benefited party of all Closing conditions that may lawfully be waived. All mandatory Closing conditions required by law shall be fulfilled. Closing confirmation requires Buyer’s express written confirmation. 9. Replacement of Section 6.2. Section 6.2 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced with the following: 6.2 Closing Deadline and Termination. If the conditions under Section 5.4 are satisfied or duly waived, the parties shall close in accordance with Sections 4.3 and 5.1. If those conditions are not satisfied or duly waived by the Closing Deadline, Buyer may terminate by written notice to Seller, whereupon Section 4.4 shall govern the parties’ remaining payment obligations and treatment of the Down Payment. An extension requires Buyer’s and Seller’s written agreement. Any earlier termination for due diligence issues under Section 5.3 remains subject to that Section’s requirements. Termination does not extinguish independently accrued breach claims. 10. Payment Defaults and Survival. Section 6.3 of the Agreement is deleted and replaced with the following: 6.3 If a material breach is not cured within ten (10) Business Days after receipt of written notice from the non-breaching party, the non-breaching party may terminate the uncompleted transaction by written notice and recover actual losses and reasonable enforcement costs. The Closing Deadline under Section 5.1 shall continue to apply during the cure period; any extension requires written agreement between Buyer and Seller. Buyer’s termination rights under Sections 5.3 and 6.2 remain effective, and any entitlement to repayment of the Down Payment shall be governed exclusively by Section 4.4. Buyer’s failure to pay the Down Payment constitutes a payment breach only when payment is due under Section 4.2. Buyer’s failure to pay the remaining purchase price constitutes a payment breach only when payment is due under Sections 4.3 and 5.1, all applicable Closing conditions have been satisfied or duly waived in writing by the benefited party to the extent legally permissible, and Seller is ready and able to deliver all equity interests and control simultaneously with such payment. 3 11. Elimination of Escrow; Prior Funding Obligation. The parties confirm that no deposit has been funded and no escrow agreement has been executed in connection with the Agreement. All requirements to establish or fund an escrow account or attorney trust account, appoint an Escrow Agent, obtain escrow instructions, or obtain an escrow release are deleted. The Escrow Agent Acceptance attached to the Agreement is deleted in its entirety. Seller waives any default or claim arising solely from Buyer’s failure to fund the deposit required by former Section 4.2 before the Amendment Effective Date. This limited waiver does not release unrelated claims. 12. Conforming References. References in the Agreement to the “Deposit,” “Refundable Deposit,” or “purchase deposit” shall mean the Down Payment, whose refundability is governed exclusively by Section 4.4 as amended hereby. References to Closing deadlines, payment timing, and escrow mechanics shall be construed consistently with this Amendment. No reference in the Agreement to a refundable deposit or escrow refund shall create an independent repayment right inconsistent with amended Section 4.4. 13. The following is added as Section 2.4 of the Agreement: Any potential acquisition of rights to additional power capacity for the Project shall be a separate transaction, subject to applicable approvals and a separate written agreement specifying the capacity, purchase price, payment terms, delivery requirements and other agreed conditions. Neither party is obligated under this Amendment to purchase, sell or pay for such additional capacity, and neither party represents or guarantees that such capacity will be approved or available. The approval, availability, negotiation or acquisition of such additional capacity shall not constitute a condition to Closing or modify, delay or excuse either party’s obligations under the Agreement as amended hereby, including the purchase price, payment obligations and Closing Deadline, unless Buyer and Seller expressly agree otherwise in writing. 14. Continuing Effect; Priority. Except as expressly amended hereby, the Agreement remains in full force and effect. This Amendment forms part of the Agreement and controls in the event of any conflict. References to the Agreement shall mean the Agreement as amended hereby. This Amendment does not release VAI from its obligations, change the identity of Seller or the Acquiring Entity, or alter the purchase price or the separate economic arrangements expressly preserved herein. The Target Company acknowledges this Amendment and reaffirms its cooperation and other obligations under the Agreement as amended hereby. 15. Governing Law; Notices; Execution. Sections 7.1 and 7.2 of the Agreement apply to this Amendment. This Amendment may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is deemed an original and all of which constitute one instrument. Further amendments require a writing signed by Buyer and Seller. This Amendment is executed in English; if translated, the English text shall control in the event of inconsistency, consistent with Section 7.4 of the Agreement. [Signature Page Follows] 4 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned have executed this Amendment. Seller (holder(s) of 100% of the equity interests of the Target Company; if multiple, jointly and severally liable for Seller’s obligations): Seller signature: /s/ Ke Gao Name: Ke Gao Date: 11/3/2026 Buyer Valor Energy Inc. Authorized signature: /s/ Ronggang Zhang Name and title: Ronggang Zhang | CEO Date: 11/3/2026 Notice address: 230 Park Avenue, Floor 3, New York, NY 10169 Notice email: [ *]

text: EX-10.1 2 ex10-1.htm EX-10.1 Exhibit 10.1 19505 Biscayne Blvd. ● Suite 2350 ● Aventura, FL 33180 ● legal@ascentpartnersllc.com To: Our Bond, Inc. 18 West 18th Street, 6th Floor New York, NY 10011 Email: Doron.Kempel@ourbond.com Attention: Doron Kempel Chief Executive Officer November 5, 2026 Re: Amendment to Securities Purchase Agreement dated November 3, 2026 Dear Mr. Kempel: Reference is made to the Securities Purchase Agreement under which Ascent Partners Fund LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the “Purchaser ”) may purchase shares of common stock of Our Bond, Inc., a Nevada corporation (together with its successors and permitted assigns, the “ Company ”) at a price of $2.75 per share subject to the terms and conditions set forth therein (the “ SPA ”). Subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein, and effective on the date hereof, the SPA is hereby amended as follows: 1. Section 4.10 of the SPA is amended and restated to read, in its entirety, as follows: 4.10 Subsequent Equity Sales . (a) From the date hereof until the one (1) year anniversary of the Closing Date, the Company shall be prohibited from effecting or entering into an agreement to effect any issuance by the Company or any of its Subsidiaries of shares of Common Stock or Common Stock Equivalents (or a combination of units thereof) involving a Variable Rate Transaction. “ Variable Rate Transaction ” means a transaction in which the Company (i) issues or sells any debt or equity securities that are convertible into, exchangeable or exercisable for, or include the right to receive additional shares of Common Stock either (A) at a conversion price, exercise price or exchange rate or other price that is based upon and/or varies with the trading prices of or quotations for the Common Stock at any time after the initial issuance of such debt or equity securities, or (B) with a conversion, exercise or exchange price that is subject to being reset at some future date after the initial issuance of such debt or equity security or upon the occurrence of specified or contingent events directly or indirectly related to the business of the Company or the market for shares of Common Stock or (ii) enters into, or effects a transaction under, any agreement, including, but not limited to, an equity line of credit or an “at-the-market offering”, whereby the Company may issue securities at a future determined price regardless of whether shares pursuant to such agreement have actually been issued and regardless of whether such agreement is subsequently canceled. The Purchaser shall be entitled to obtain injunctive relief against the Company to preclude any such issuance, which remedy shall be in addition to any right to collect damages. (b) Notwithstanding Section 4.10(a), the Company may continue the existing equity line with Ascent Partners Fund LLC under the Securities Purchase Agreement dated October 27, 2025, as amended, including its existing draw and issuance arrangements, notwithstanding its characterization as a Variable Rate Transaction. This exception is solely a carve-out from the restrictions in this Section; it does not incorporate another agreement, supply consideration for this purchase or condition the Closing on another transaction. Except as expressly provided herein, no other Variable Rate Transaction is permitted by this exception and Section 4.10 shall not apply to an Exempt Issuance. 2. Except as expressly amended by this Amendment, all of the terms and conditions of the SPA remain unchanged and in full force and effect. This amendment is a Transaction Document and is limited as written. As of the date first written above, each reference in the SPA to “ this Agreement ” “ hereunder ,” “ hereof ,” “ herein ,” or words of like import, and each reference in the other Transaction Documents to the SPA (including, without limitation, by means of words like “ thereunder ,” “ thereof ” and words of like import), shall refer to the SPA as modified hereby, and the provisions in this amendment amending the SPA shall be read together and construed as a single agreement with the SPA. The execution, delivery and effectiveness of this amendment shall not, except as expressly provided herein, commit or otherwise obligate the Purchaser to enter into or consider entering into any other consent, waiver or modification of any Transaction Document or make any further purchases or other advances pursuant to any Transaction Documents. In further consideration for the execution of this amendment by the Purchaser and without limiting any rights or remedies the Purchaser or any Purchaser Parties may have, the Company hereby releases each of the Purchaser and the Purchaser Parties (each a “ Releasee ” and, collectively, the “ Releasees ”) against any and all claims and from any other losses of the Company or any Subsidiary thereof, whether or not relating to any Transaction Document, any obligation or liability owing thereunder, any asset of the Company or any of their Subsidiaries or Affiliates, or any legal relationship that exists or may exist between any Releasee and the Company or any Subsidiary of the Company. The Company, for itself and for its Subsidiaries, acknowledges and agrees that it or its Subsidiaries may discover information later that could have affected materially their willingness to agree to the release in this paragraph and that neither such possibility, which it took into account when executing this amendment, nor such discovery, as to which it expressly assumes the risk, shall affect the effectiveness of the release in this paragraph, and waives the benefit of any legal requirement that may provide otherwise. As a Transaction Document, and pursuant to the SPA, this Amendment is subject to various interpretative, amendment, other miscellaneous provisions set forth in the SPA that expressly apply to Transaction Documents, located principally in Article V thereof, including Sections 5.2 (Fees and Expenses), 5.5 (Amendments; Waivers), 5.16 (Set Aside), 5.12 (Severability) and 5.19 (Construction) , but also Sections 3.1 (Representations and Warranties of the Company (including clause (nn) (AML/CTF Regulations)), and 4.8 (Indemnification of Purchaser ), which the Company, in the case of representations and warranties, expressly makes herein for the benefit of the Purchaser whenever those are made under the SPA, and, for other provisions, agrees to comply therewith. In addition, without limitation, (a) Section 5.9 (Governing Law) of the SPA provides that this Amendment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York and that all proceedings in respect hereto shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts sitting in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan and (b) in Section 5.20 (Waiver of Jury Trial) , the parties thereto (which include the parties hereto) thereby irrevocably and unconditionally waived, to the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, any right that they may have to trial by jury of any claim or cause of action or in any proceeding, directly or indirectly based upon or arising out of, under or in connection with, this Amendment or the transactions contemplated therein or related thereto (whether founded in contract, tort or any other theory). The parties hereto hereby reaffirm all of these and all other provisions of the Transaction Documents applying to the Transaction Documents as applying to this amendment, all of which are hereby incorporated herein by reference. [ Signature Pages Follow ] This Amendment may be executed in counterparts, which may be effectively transmitted by fax or e-mail (in each case return receipt requested and obtained) and which, together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Very truly yours, ASCENT PARTNERS FUND LLC, as Purchaser By: /s/ Mikhail Gurevich Name: Mikhail Gurevich Title: Authorized Person Accepted and Agreed As of the Date First Written Above: Our Bond, Inc., as Company By: /s/ Doron Kempel Name: Doron Kempel Title: Chief Executive Officer

title: Valion Bio, Inc.
text: EX-10.1 2 valion_ex1001.htm LETTER AGREEMENT Exhibit 10.1 November 6, 2026 3i, LP 2 Wooster Street, 2nd Floor New York, NY 10013 Attention: Maier J. Tarlow Re: Fifth Side Letter — Closing under Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement Dear Mr. Tarlow: This letter agreement (this “Letter Agreement”) is entered into as of the date first written above, by and between Valion Bio, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”), and 3i, LP, a Delaware limited partnership (the “Purchaser”). The Company and the Purchaser are party to that certain Securities Purchase Agreement, dated April 29, 2025 (as assigned and amended as of December 9, 2025, the “Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement”), with respect to the purchase and sale of up to 8,400 shares of the Company’s Series B Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock (“Series B Preferred Shares”) and warrants (“Series B Warrants”) to purchase shares of common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, of the Company (the “Common Stock”) at an initial exercise price determined pursuant to Section 2.2 of the Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement, for an aggregate purchase price of up to $8,400,000 in a series of closings. As of the date hereof, the Purchaser has the option, but not the obligation, to purchase up to 1,550 Series B Preferred Shares and corresponding Series B Warrants for an aggregate purchase price of up to $1,550,000. The Company, the Purchaser and certain other purchasers are party to that certain Securities Purchase Agreement, dated as of December 9, 2025 (the “Series C Preferred Purchase Agreement”), with respect to the purchase and sale of (a) up to 75,000 shares of the Company’s Series C Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock (“Series C Preferred Shares”) and (b) warrants (“Series C Warrants”) to purchase a number of shares of Common Stock calculated pursuant to Section 2.2 of the Series C Preferred Purchase Agreement at an initial exercise price per share equal to the Fixed Conversion Price, as defined in the Certificate of Designation of Preferences, Rights and Limitations of the Series C Preferred Shares (the “Series C Certificate of Designation”), for an aggregate purchase price of up to $75,000,000 in a series of closings. As of the date hereof, the Purchaser has purchased 13,637 Series C Preferred Shares and corresponding Series C Warrants for an aggregate purchase price of $13,637,000, and has the right, subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the Series C Preferred Purchase Agreement, to purchase up to an additional 23,863 Series C Preferred Shares and corresponding Series C Warrants for an aggregate purchase price of up to $23,863,000. The Company and the Purchaser are also party to that certain Securities Purchase Agreement, dated as of December 9, 2025, pursuant to which the Company issued to the Purchaser a Senior Secured Convertible Note in the original principal amount of $16,253,147.10 (the “Note”) and a warrant to purchase 182,129 shares of Common Stock (the “Note Warrant”). Capitalized terms not defined herein shall have the meanings assigned thereto in the Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement. The Company and the Purchaser hereby agree as follows: 1. Closing . The Purchaser agrees, upon the satisfaction of the conditions set forth in Section 2, to purchase from the Company, and the Company agrees to issue to the Purchaser, in a closing (the “Closing”), (a) 700 Series B Preferred Shares (the “Closing Series B Shares”) and (b) Series B Warrants to purchase 21,539 shares of Common Stock at an initial exercise price of $0.5182 per share (the “Closing Series B Warrants”), for an aggregate purchase price of $700,000 (the “Closing Purchase Price”), subject to the satisfaction or waiver by the Purchaser of each of the conditions set forth in Section 2. At the Closing, the Purchaser shall pay the Closing Purchase Price to the Company in immediately available funds by wire transfer. 1 2. Closing Conditions . The obligations of the Purchaser hereunder in connection with the Closing are subject to each of the following conditions being satisfied or waived by the Purchaser prior to or at the Closing: (a) Each of the conditions set forth in Sections 2.3(b) and 2.3(h) of the Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement shall have been satisfied or waived by the Purchaser. (b) The Purchaser shall have received the Closing Series B Shares and the Closing Series B Warrants. (c) The Purchaser shall have received each of the following deliverables required pursuant to Section 2.3(l) of the Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement: (i) a certificate evidencing the Closing Series B Shares; (ii) the Closing Series B Warrants, duly executed by the Company; and (iii) all other documents, instruments and writings required to be delivered by the Company to the Purchaser on or before the Closing pursuant to the Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement or otherwise necessary to implement and effect the transactions contemplated thereby and hereby. (d) The Company shall have delivered to the Purchaser a written notice, in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to the Purchaser, setting forth each price adjustment triggered by the Closing pursuant to the terms of the Series B Preferred Shares, the Series B Warrants, the Series C Preferred Shares, the Series C Warrants, the Note and the Note Warrant, including the resulting adjusted conversion or exercise price and any additional securities issuable as a result thereof. (e) The Common Stock shall be listed on the Nasdaq Capital Market (“Nasdaq”), the Company shall be in compliance with all applicable listing and maintenance requirements of Nasdaq and the Company shall have no reason to believe that it will not continue to comply with such requirements. 3. Registration Rights . The Company hereby agrees to use its commercially reasonable efforts to (a) file with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”), no later than 30 days from the date of the Closing, a registration statement (the “Registration Statement”) covering the maximum number of shares of Common Stock issuable upon conversion of the Closing Series B Shares and the shares of Common Stock issuable upon exercise of the Closing Series B Warrants so as to permit the resale of such securities by the Purchaser, (b) have the Registration Statement declared effective by the SEC no later than 60 days from the date of the Closing, and (c) keep the Registration Statement effective, including but not limited to pursuant to Rule 415 promulgated under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and available for the resale by the Purchaser of all of the securities covered thereby at all times until the date on which the Purchaser shall have sold all the securities covered thereby or they cease to require registration pursuant to this paragraph. 4. Amendment to Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement . The defined term of “Termination Date” set forth in the Series B Preferred Purchase Agreement is hereby amended and restated as follows: ““ Termination Date ” shall mean December 9, 2027.” 5. Counterparts; Electronic Signatures . This Letter Agreement may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which, taken together, shall constitute one and the same instrument. Signatures transmitted by electronic means (including DocuSign or similar electronic signature platforms) shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes. 2 6. Governing Law . This Letter Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict of laws principles. 7. No Other Modification . Except as expressly set forth in this Letter Agreement, this Letter Agreement shall not amend, modify or waive any provision of any agreement or instrument between the Company and the Purchaser, each of which shall remain in full force and effect in accordance with its terms. [Signature Page to Follow] 3 [Signature Page to Side Letter] Please confirm the Purchaser’s agreement to the foregoing by executing this Letter Agreement in the space provided below. Very truly yours, Valion Bio, Inc. By: /s/ Lisa Wolf Name: Lisa Wolf Title: Chief Operating Officer AGREED AND ACCEPTED: 3i, LP By: 3i Management LLC, its General Partner By: /s/ Maier J.
