Witz (“ Executive ”) as follows: 1. Executive’s employment with Sirius XM Radio LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the “ Company ”, and together with its parents, subsidiaries and affiliates, including Sirius XM Holdings Inc., a Delaware corporation (“ Holdings ”), the “ Company Group ” and references to the Company Group in this Second Release shall be considered references to each member of the Company Group), ended on December 31, 2026 (the “ Separation Date ”). 2. Subject to Executive’s timely execution and non-revocation of this Second Release, Executive shall be provided the payments to be made to Executive under Section 3 of the Transition Agreement between Executive and Sirius XM Radio LLC, dated as of November 7, 2026, 2026 (the “ Agreement ”). Executive acknowledges and agrees that Executive is entering into this Second Release in consideration of such payments and that such payments are more than Executive would be entitled to receive if Executive did not enter into this Second Release. Executive understands that Executive will not be eligible for any compensation or benefits following the Separation Date other than the payments set forth under Sections 1 and 3 of the Agreement and any rights to indemnification and to directors’ and officers’ liability insurance provided by the Company or Holdings or in accordance with applicable law; provided , that such indemnification and directors’ and officers’ liability insurance shall be provided in a manner consistent with indemnification and directors’ and officers’ liability insurance provided to other former directors and officers. Executive acknowledges and agrees that Executive has not suffered any job-related wrongs or injuries for which Executive might still be entitled to compensation, and Executive has been paid all wages, compensation and benefits that Executive was entitled to up to and including the date this Second Release is signed by Executive. 3. Executive has and will continue to comply with the restrictions, obligations and acknowledgements set forth in Sections 2 and 5 of the Agreement (including the incorporation by reference of Sections 7, 8 and 10 of the Employment Agreement, and such restrictions, obligations and acknowledgements, together, the “ Restrictive Covenants ”), and Executive expressly acknowledges that the Restrictive Covenants shall survive Executive’s termination of employment. Executive reaffirms the Restrictive Covenants (which include covenants with respect to confidentiality, non-competition, non-solicitation and non-disparagement), and the Restrictive Covenants are hereby incorporated into and form a part of this Second Release. Executive warrants that Executive has returned to the Company all property of the Company Group in Executive’s possession or control; provided, that Executive will be able to keep (i) Executive’s cell phones, personal computers, personal contact list and the like so long as any Confidential Information (as defined in the Employment Agreement) is removed from such items, and (ii) any such information, documents, or equipment as determined by the Company to be necessary for Executive to retain during the Consulting Period (as defined in the Agreement); provided, further, that the Executive shall keep Executive’s email address with the Company and Company-provided laptop computer during the Consulting Period. 4. Executive, with the intention of binding Executive and Executive’s heirs, attorneys, agents, spouse and assigns, hereby irrevocably and unconditionally waives, releases and forever discharges the Company Group and its respective parents, subsidiaries and affiliates and its and their predecessors, successors, assigns, and its and their officers, directors, employees, stockholders, agents, servants, representatives and attorneys, and the predecessors, successors, heirs and assigns of each of them (collectively, the “ Released Parties ”), from any and all claims, actions, causes of action, rights, judgements, obligations, damages, demands, accountings, grievances and liabilities of any kind or character or nature whatsoever, whether known or unknown, suspected or claimed, that Executive ever had, now has, or claims to have against the Released Parties arising out of or relating to Executive’s employment with or separation from the Company Group, including but not limited to Executive’s termination of employment, by reason of any act or omission occurring before Executive’s execution of this Second Release, including, without limiting the generality of the foregoing: (i) any act, cause, matter or thing stated, claimed or alleged, or which was or which could have been alleged in any manner against the Released Parties prior to the execution of this Second Release; (ii) all claims for any payment under the Employment Agreement; (iii) all claims for discrimination, harassment or retaliation; and (iv) under the Older Workers Benefit Protection Act (“ OWBPA ”), Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, the Civil Rights Act of 1991, the New York State Human Rights Law, the New York City Human Rights Law, the Americans with Disabilities Act, the Family and Medical Leave Act and the Employee Retirement Income Security Act, in each case as amended, as well as any and all claims arising out of any alleged contract of employment, whether written, oral, express or implied, or any other federal, state or local civil or human rights or labor law, ordinances, rules, regulations, guidelines, statutes, common law, contract or tort law; provided that nothing contained in this Second Release shall affect Executive’s rights: (1) to accrued vested benefits under employee benefit plans; (2) to indemnification or directors’ and officers’ liability insurance provided by the Company or Holdings or in accordance with applicable law; (3) that cannot be waived as a matter of law; (4) under the Agreement that survive termination; (5) with respect to workmen’s compensation or similar claims under applicable law; or (6) to any equity awards that are vested. Subject to the foregoing proviso, Executive expressly waives all rights afforded by any statute that expressly limits the effect of a release with respect to unknown claims. Executive understands the significance of this Release of unknown claims and the waiver of statutory protection against a release of unknown claims. 5. Pursuant to the OWBPA, Executive specifically waives all rights or claims that Executive has or may have under the Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967, 29 U.S.C. §§ 621-634, as amended (“ ADEA ”), including, without limitation, those arising out of or relating to Executive’s employment with and separation from the Company Group, the termination of Executive’s employment on the Separation Date, and any events occurring prior to the execution of this Second Release. This Second Release is written in a manner calculated to be understood by Executive. In accordance with the ADEA, the Company specifically hereby advises Executive that: (i) Executive may and should consult an attorney before signing this Second Release; (ii) Executive has 21 days (or 45 days if part of a group termination) to consider this Second Release; and (iii) Executive has seven days following execution of this Second Release to revoke this Second Release. This Second Release shall not become effective until the 8 th day after execution by Executive. 6. Nothing in this Second Release prevents or precludes Executive from: (i) challenging or seeking a determination of the validity of this Second Release under the ADEA; (ii) filing an administrative charge of discrimination under any applicable statute or participating in any investigation or proceeding conducted by a governmental agency; (iii) making any disclosure of information required by law; (iv) providing information to, or testifying or otherwise assisting in any investigation or proceeding brought by, any federal regulatory or law enforcement agency or legislative body, any self-regulatory organization, or the Company Group’s legal, compliance, or human resources officers; or (v) filing, testifying, participating in, or otherwise assisting in a proceeding relating to an alleged violation of any federal, state, or municipal law relating to fraud or any rule or regulation of the Securities and Exchange Commission or any self-regulatory organization. ii 7. Executive acknowledges that Executive may hereafter discover claims or facts in addition to or different from those which Executive now knows or believes to exist with respect to the subject matter of this Second Release which, if known or suspected at the time Executive executes this Second Release, may have materially affected this Second Release and Executive’s decision to enter into it. Nevertheless, except to the extent expressly not waived as part of this Second Release, Executive hereby waives any right, claim or cause of action that might arise as a result of such different or additional claims or facts. 8. Executive warrants that Executive has not made any assignment, transfer, conveyance or alienation of any potential claim, cause of action or any right of any kind whatsoever, including but not limited to, potential claims and remedies for discrimination, harassment, retaliation or wrongful termination, and that no other person or entity of any kind has had, or now has, any financial or other interest in any of the demands, obligations, causes of action, debts, liabilities, rights, contracts, damages, costs, expenses, losses or claims that could have been asserted by Executive against any Released Party. 9. This Second Release shall not be construed as an admission by any Released Party of any violation, liability or wrongdoing, and shall not be admissible in any proceeding as evidence of or an admission by any Released Party of any violation or wrongdoing. 10. Executive hereby agrees and recognizes that the Company Group has no obligation, contractual or otherwise, to Executive to hire, rehire or reemploy Executive in the future. Executive acknowledges that the terms of this Second Release provide Executive with payments that are in addition to any amounts to which Executive otherwise would have been entitled. 11. Sections 7, 8 and 9 of the Agreement shall be incorporated herein by reference as if set forth herein mutatis mutandis . 12. Executive may take up to 21 days after receipt of this Second Release to review and sign this Second Release. Executive is free to sign this Second Release at any time after receiving it, without using the entire review period. Executive is encouraged, during the review period and before signing this Second Release, to consult with an attorney as to this Second Release’s meaning and implications. If this Second Release is not signed and timely returned, the offer and payments presented in Section 3 of the Agreement shall be deemed revoked. Executive understands that Executive may revoke this Second Release within seven days following Executive’s execution of this Second Release by notice to the Company in accordance with Section 9 of the Agreement. The Company’s obligation to provide the payments set forth in Section 3 of the Agreement shall not become effective or enforceable against the Company until the eighth day after Executive’s execution and delivery to the Company of this Second Release. If Executive revokes this Second Release after signing, Executive shall be obligated to fully reimburse the Company for payments made under Section 3 of the Agreement. iii 13. By signing this Second Release, Executive represents that Executive has been afforded a reasonable period of time within which to consider the terms of this Second Release, that Executive has read this Second Release, and Executive is fully aware of its legal effects . Executive further represents and warrants that Executive has entered into this Second Release knowingly and voluntarily, without any mistake, duress, coercion or undue influence, and that Executive has been advised by the Company to, and Executive has been provided the opportunity to, review this Second Release with an attorney of Executive’s own choosing. Executive acknowledges, further, that Executive is executing this Second Release of Executive’s own volition and with the intention of releasing all claims recited herein in exchange for the consideration described in this Second Release, which Executive acknowledges is adequate and satisfactory to Executive. None of the Company Group or its agents, representatives or attorneys have made any representations to Executive concerning the terms or effects of this Second Release other than those contained herein. [Signature Page to Follow] iv IN WITNESS WHEREOF , Executive has executed this Second Release as of the respective date set forth below. EXECUTIVE Jennifer C. Witz Date: NOTE: DO NOT SIGN THIS SECOND RELEASE BEFORE THE SEPARATION DATE. [Signature Page to Second Release]

text: EX-10.1 2 ef20085161_ex10-1.htm EXHIBIT 10.1 Exhibit 10.1 November 2, 2026 Via E-mail Cathy Cooper Dear Cathy: As you are aware, on September 6, 2026, WaFd, Inc. (the “ Company ”) entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “ Merger Agreement ”) with EverBank Financial Corp. (“ EverBank ”), pursuant to which EverBank will, subject to the terms and conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement, merge with and into the Company (the “ Merger ”), with the Company as the surviving corporation (hereinafter referred to in such capacity and together with EverBank, National Association, as the “ Surviving Corporation ”). Reference is made to your Change of Control Agreement with the Company, dated as of January 24, 2018 (the “ CIC Agreement ”). Effective as of, and subject to and contingent upon, the closing of the Merger (the “ Closing ”), in consideration for the promises and mutual covenants in the Merger Agreement, including your continued employment with the Surviving Corporation and the benefits you will receive in connection with the Merger, including the Continuity Payment (as defined below), you and the Company agree as set forth below. For the avoidance of doubt, in the event the Merger Agreement is terminated in accordance with its terms, this letter agreement will be null and void ab initio and your CIC Agreement shall continue in full force and effect following such termination. In consideration of your efforts toward the completion of the Merger and the covenants and waivers set forth herein, and in settlement of all of your rights under the CIC Agreement, the Surviving Corporation shall pay you a lump sum cash payment in the amount of $1,650,000 (the “ Continuity Payment ”), less applicable tax withholdings, payable within 60 days following the Closing, subject to your continued employment through the Closing. Payment of the Continuity Payment is subject to your execution of a release of claims in a form provided by the Surviving Corporation, as contemplated by the CIC Agreement. You hereby acknowledge and agree that, effective as of and following the Closing, (i) (a) any diminution of your authority, duties, or responsibilities, (b) any diminution in the authority, duties, or responsibilities of the supervisor(s) to whom you are required to report, including a requirement that you report to a corporate officer or employee instead of reporting directly to the Company’s Board of Directors immediately following the Merger, (c) any diminution in the budget over which you retain authority, or (d) any other action that would have constituted a material breach of the CIC Agreement (including failure of the Company’s successors to assume the CIC Agreement), in each case, in connection with your transition to your new role, as shall be determined prior to the Closing, with the Surviving Corporation immediately following the consummation of the transactions contemplated in the Merger Agreement, will not constitute “Good Reason” for purposes of the CIC Agreement or any other applicable arrangement or agreement you may have with the Company or any affiliate; (ii) you hereby waive any and all rights or claims to any payments or benefits you may have been entitled to thereunder as a result of such a modification; (iii) you hereby waive the “Good Reason” trigger under Section 4(c)(iii) of the CIC Agreement relating to a material change in the geographic location at which you must perform services following the Closing, but only to the extent that, following the Closing, you are required to be principally employed at a location not more than 30 miles from the current location of the Company’s offices in Seattle, Washington or from Bellevue, Washington; and (iv) the Surviving Corporation and its subsidiaries and affiliates shall have no further obligations to you under the CIC Agreement. Any modification of the terms of this letter agreement shall only be valid if made in writing and signed by the parties hereto. This letter agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Washington without regard to its conflict-of-law rules and each of the parties hereby submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of any federal or state court sitting in the State of Washington with respect to any claim or action arising out of or relating to this letter agreement. [ Signature pages follow ] 2 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have caused this letter agreement to be executed as of the date first written above. WAFD, INC.
